description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. If you are a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team committed to resident well-being and professional excellence. We are looking for a candidate who is eager to make a significant impact within our facility.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare environment
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: $60,000 - $75,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
